fieldValues.title: Every write refuses loudly what it cannot carry
fieldValues.move: Every write path (CLI, MCP, WASM) checks the type and relation contracts and either writes all of a request or none of it. It returns a coded error for anything it cannot preserve: an unknown field, a partial batch, a shape it does not understand. A conformance fixture proves each refusal.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Agents that bypass the tools and write files by hand; meaning that is valid but wrong.
fieldValues.falsifier: A conformance or regression test in which a write path reports success while dropping, truncating or only partly writing what it was given.
source_ref: srs-programme: domain health walk of Semantic records, 2026-10-20
fieldValues.return_when: When a silent loss is reported from any client, or at the next conformance pass.
